sources.name: AJGA
sources.note: Read the AJGA 2026 schedule, the 2027 schedule, and the PING Invitational event and info pages. The only AL/MS/LA/Gulf-Coast-area item on either list is none; the one Florida event on the 2027 list (The Nelly Invitational, Bradenton) has no date on any page I read. The PING Invitational (Tallahassee, FL) is officially November 5–8, 2026, so it starts before today's window and is excluded. The 2027 page showed a "Load More" button I could not expand, so later 2027 rows were not visible to me.

sources.name: Alabama Golf Association
sources.note: The schedule page https://www.alabamagolf.org/championships failed to load on two fetch attempts, so I could not read any tournament dates from it. A search turned up AGA-related pages and amateurgolf.com listings, but the 2026 events in those results all started before today (2026-11-07), and I did not use them to fill in a schedule. No tournaments could be verified, so the list is empty and the schedule page should be rechecked later.

sources.name: Dixie Section PGA
sources.note: The dixie.pga.com homepage returned a cached page dated 2015 with no junior schedule, and the schedule URL could not be fetched directly. Searches surfaced only past or non-Dixie-hosted listings (e.g., 2026 Alabama-NW Florida Junior PGA Championship on June 11-12/16-17, 2026, and 2023/2024 AJGO events), none starting between 2026-11-07 and 2027-11-07. No upcoming qualifying tournament could be verified, so none is reported.

sources.name: Drive, Chip & Putt
sources.note: Fetching https://www.drivechipandputt.com/registration failed on two attempts with a connection error, so the schedule page was not read. A later attempt at the site root was rejected because that URL had not appeared in the task. Search results only returned other organizations' Drive, Chip & Putt pages (state PGA sites, Indiana, Michigan), which are not this organization's schedule, so nothing was reported. Re-run once the registration page is reachable.

sources.name: Emerald Coast Junior Golf Tour
sources.note: The provided domain (emeraldcoastjuniorgolftour.com) returned a permission error. I read the tour's official schedule at ecjrgolftour.com/Tournament, which lists 2027 events with dates; the 2026 events are all before today. Per-event detail pages were not opened, so fees, divisions, and registration-close dates are null unless the schedule showed them. Ages 15-18 appear only in the Kelly Plantation event name. Enterprise CC Junior Classic (June 26-27, 2027) was excluded as an inland, non-qualifier event.

sources.name: FCWT Junior Golf Tour
sources.note: Fetched https://www.fcwtgolf.com. The page is a 2014-2015 snapshot ("Welcome to the 2014-2015 FCWT Junior Golf Tour"). Its schedule table did not load and it contains no links to a current schedule or event pages, so no FCWT dates could be read. A web search returned only other organizations' events (FCG, FSGA), not FCWT events, so nothing was reported. The FCWT schedule is unverified and should be checked directly with the organizer.

sources.name: FSGA / Florida Junior Tour
sources.note: The FSGA juniors schedule page (https://www.fsga.org/juniors) failed to load on two attempts, so I could not read its schedule directly. Search snippets and the FJT tournament-category page only showed 2026 events dated on or before October 10, 2026, all before today (2026-11-07). I found no tournament dated between 2026-11-07 and 2027-11-07 in the places I could read, so nothing is reported. The schedule page should be rechecked when it is reachable, since 2027 events may already be posted there.

sources.name: Gulf States PGA
sources.note: gulfstates.pga.com and gulfpga.bluegolf.com (the 2026/2027 tournament schedule host) both refused access, so the 2027 schedule could not be read. I read the Gulf States PGA Junior Events page (gspga.com/allied-junior-calendar/), which lists only the 2026 Boys and Girls Junior PGA Championships (June 24-25, Alexandria, LA), already past as of 2026-11-07. No upcoming junior event with a verified date in the window was found, so none are reported; the external tour schedules linked from that page were not read.

sources.name: HJGT (Hurricane Junior Golf Tour)
sources.note: returned no tournaments (had 5); kept the previous list. Read the HJGT schedule page and the Alabama and Florida state pages (Mississippi has no page, per instructions). Upcoming events on those pages in AL and FL, from 2026-11-07 on, are either far from the Gulf Coast Panhandle or not championship/national/qualifier events: Huntsville Junior Open (AL, Nov 14-15, Sylacauga, inland), and Florida's Sarasota Junior Open (Nov 7-8), Winter Garden Junior Open (Nov 7-8), Reunion Junior Open (Nov 14-15), and Southeast Florida Junior Open (Nov 14-15), all outside the Pensacola-to-Tallahassee area. The Florida page also lists a Sarasota event, which I excluded because Sarasota is not in the Panhandle. I did not open individual event pages, since none of these qualified on location or type.

sources.name: IJGT (International Junior Golf Tour)
sources.note: Fetched the IJGT home page (ijgt.com), which links to the tournament schedule at bluegolf.ijgt.com/bluegolf/ijgt23/schedule/index.htm. That schedule page, and the ijgt22 variant, returned "You don't have permission to access this domain," so no event dates, ages, or locations could be read. No tournaments are reported because none could be verified.

sources.name: Junior Orange Bowl
sources.note: The schedule page https://jrorangebowl.org could not be fetched (tried with and without trailing slash). I read the organization's events calendar at juniororangebowl.org/events-calendar instead, which lists only one golf event, the International Golf Tournament (Jan 3–6, 2026, Biltmore Golf Course, Coral Gables FL). That date is before today (2026-11-07), so nothing qualifies. No upcoming golf event appeared on any page I could read, so the list is empty. The org's main schedule page should be rechecked when it is reachable.

sources.name: Louisiana Golf Association
sources.note: Read the LGA home page and the 2026 LGA Schedule (lgagolf.org/2026-lga-schedule/). Its only junior events (Louisiana Boys' and Girls' Junior Amateurs) were July 8-10, 2026, which is already past. Also read the Louisiana Junior Golf Tour (LJGT) 2027 schedule, linked from the LGA site, which lists one 2027 event: the 9th Sam Burns Junior Four-Ball Championship, Feb 27-28, 2027, Squire Creek CC, Choudrant, LA. I excluded it because it is in north Louisiana, far from the Gulf Coast, and the page does not describe it as a state championship. The LJGT Bayou Cup (Dec 4-6, 2026) is in Columbus, TX, outside the target states.

sources.name: Mississippi Golf Association
sources.note: Fetched https://www.msgolf.org (the only page the schedule link pointed to). It does not contain a junior tournament schedule. It shows a single event, a National MS Society golf tournament at Stoney Creek Golf Club on May 4, 2026, with no age divisions, is not a junior event, and that date has passed. No individual event pages were linked, so I did not follow any further links.

sources.name: NB3 Junior Golf National Championship
sources.note: The schedule page https://www.nb3jgnc.com returned "You don't have permission to access this domain" on two attempts, and a guessed sub-path was refused, so I could not read any tournament dates from the organization's own pages. A web search surfaced third-party reports of the 2026 NB3 national championship at Koasati Pines in Kinder, LA (girls Nov 1-3, boys Nov 6-8, 2026), but those began before the 2026-11-07 window and came from non-organization sites, so I did not report them. The schedule needs to be checked directly once the site is accessible.

sources.name: North Florida PGA Junior Tour
sources.note: Fetching https://nfpga.pga.com returned "You don't have permission to access this domain," and a fetch of nfpga.pga.com/schedule was refused because that URL had not appeared in the conversation. Search results surfaced only third-party or older pages (FSGA, NFJG bluegolf, nfjg.org) and nfpga.com's Junior NFPGA Championship page, all with 2024–2026 dates before 2026-11-07 or no dates in the window, so I could not verify any upcoming event.

sources.name: Optimist Junior Golf
sources.note: The schedule page https://www.optimist.org/member/junior-golf could not be fetched (three attempts, same error), so I could not read its schedule. Web search surfaced only out-of-scope or already-past Optimist events (e.g., the July 2026 International Championship in Miami, and an older Doral Junior Classic listing from an unreliable page); none qualified, and no dates were verified from the schedule page. The schedule should be rechecked once the page is reachable.

sources.name: PKB Girls Golf Tour
sources.note: Read the homepage (pkbgt.org) and the full Upcoming Events page (pkbgt.org/schedule.php). Every listed event is in SC, NC, GA, VA, or TX (e.g., Hilton Head SC, Wilmington NC, Savannah GA, Houston TX, Williamsburg VA). None are in AL, FL, MS, or LA, so no tournaments qualified. Only one event in the list had no location detail ("Southeastern Girls Classic, TBD, GA"), and it is also outside the target states.

sources.name: Press Thornton Future Masters
sources.note: Read https://www.futuremasters.org (redirects to futuremasters.org) and its only linked post, /hello-world/. Neither contains a schedule, tournament names, dates, ages, or locations; the site is a WordPress placeholder with a default "Hello world!" post. No tournaments could be verified, so none are reported.

sources.name: SJGT (Southeastern Junior Golf Tour)
sources.note: The requested URL https://www.sjgt.com/schedule.aspx returned a 'Page Not Found' page. The homepage (sjgt.com) links the tournament schedule to sjgt.bluegolf.com, but both bluegolf schedule URLs returned 'You don't have permission to access this domain', and an unlinked sjgt.com/schedule/ URL was refused. No tournament dates could be read, so none are reported.

sources.name: South Florida PGA Junior Tour
sources.note: The official site (sfpga.pga.com) refused access, so I could not read it directly. I used search-result excerpts from the tour's BlueGolf schedule pages (sflpgajr.bluegolf.com, Upcoming and Recent views) and the fsga.org tour page. The only events dated after 2026-11-07 in those excerpts are the SFPGA Prep Tour Championship (Nov 14) and SFPGA Tour Championship (Dec 5-6) at The Park in West Palm Beach, FL. Both are South Florida section events, not Gulf Coast or state championships, so I excluded them. No other upcoming events in the window were visible. The excerpts may not be complete, so coverage is unverified.

sources.name: US Kids Golf
sources.note: The main schedule URL (uskidsgolf.com/.../find-a-tour) could not be fetched; I read the equivalent tournaments.uskidsgolf.com pages for the Mobile, Emerald Coast, Panama City, and Gulf Coast (LA) local tours. Panama City lists only Panama events, so none qualified. Gulf Coast tour events were excluded because its page does not state the state or city. Mobile Winter tentative dates have no year and were excluded. Baldwin County, Pensacola, Coastal MS, New Orleans/Northshore, and the AL/FL/MS/LA State Invitational pages were NOT checked (fetch limits reached), so coverage is incomplete. Local tour pages state ages 5-18 and do not publish entry fees or divisions.
